prompt: In chess, it is your turn. Your king is NOT in check, but every legal move you could make would put your king in check, and you have no other pieces to move. What is the result?

options.text: You win, because your king was never captured
You lose, because having no move forfeits the game
The game is a draw — this is stalemate
You may pass your turn and let your opponent move again

explanation: This is stalemate. A player who is not in check but has no legal move has stalemated the game, and the result is a draw — even if the other player has far more pieces left.
